name: Answered Questions
summary: The trail of Velinde Starsong leads from Ashenvale to Darnassus, where her fate awaits a report.

sections.title: A Tragic Truth
sections.body: Velinde Starsong's trail runs from Ashenvale across two continents to the haunted groves and abandoned mines of Duskwood. She took up the Scythe of Elune to defend Kalimdor from demons, then used it to summon the ferocious worgen. Velinde lost control of them and died deep in Roland's Doom mine. Duskwood was left to face the monstrous fallout.

sections.title: Return to Darnassus
sections.body: After Velinde's journal is recovered and her fate learned, Jonathan Carevin in Duskwood sends you back to Teldrassil. Sentinel Thyn'tel Bladeweaver receives your report in Darnassus. Velinde was a close friend of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, so her fate brings a personal and spiritual blow to the Sisterhood of Elune.

sections.title: A Missing Artifact
sections.body: Velinde's fate is known, but the Scythe of Elune is still missing. The goddess gave it as a sacred boon and weapon, and now it lies lost in the wild, far from the priestesses who revered it. Feral worgen roam across the Eastern Kingdoms, a lingering and unpredictable threat born from the scythe's loss.

faq.q: What is the quest Answered Questions?
aliases: end of scythe of elune quest
faq.answer: Answered Questions concludes the search for Velinde Starsong. Jonathan Carevin in Duskwood sends you to Darnassus to report her fate and the whereabouts of the Scythe of Elune to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver.

Velinde Starsong was a night elf priestess of Elune and Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow's predecessor in Ashenvale. Charged with holding back demons in Felwood, she received the Scythe of Elune, then disappeared. Her trail led across the sea to Duskwood.

faq.q: Where is the Scythe of Elune at the end of this quest?
aliases: where is the scythe of elune
faq.answer: The Scythe of Elune is still missing when you report to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus. Jonathan Carevin asks you to bring her what you learned.

faq.q: How is Tyrande Whisperwind connected to Velinde?
faq.answer: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and Velinde Starsong were close friends before Velinde disappeared. Her fate weighs heavily on night elf leaders.
Jonathan Carevin is a human resident of Duskwood who helps you search the local mines. He vows to contain the worgen there, then sends you to Kalimdor to share what you found with Velinde's people.
Thyn'tel Bladeweaver is in Darnassus, on the isle of Teldrassil. She serves the night elf leadership and oversees the search for missing sentinels and priestesses.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can help the leadership follow the trail of a missing priestess and a sacred artifact.
As a priest, you may feel the spiritual weight of Velinde's story: the power of Elune's gifts, and the danger of trying to bend unknown beasts to your will.
As an Alliance member, you see the ties between night elves in Kalimdor and the beleaguered human settlements of Duskwood, both facing shadowy threats.
